scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Special Financial Assistance for Organizing Cultural Events
other_conditions: The applicant may be an individual or a cultural group/organization/institution, registered or unregistered
The applicant must have experience organizing cultural events/programmes/exhibitions/festivals
The applicant must not be a defaulter of the Directorate of Art & Culture for non‑submission of utilization certificate or statement of accounts for any other grant received
Preference is given to registered institutions/organizations
benefits_summary: Financial grant up to ₹5,00,000 or 80% of the event expenditure (whichever is less), or up to 100% of the expenditure if the Directorate identifies the applicant suo‑moto, subject to Department discretion.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
application_link: Step 1: Visit the Directorate Of Art & Culture, Government of Goa, 5th Floor, Shram Shakti Bhavan, Panaji, Patto, Panaji, Goa - 403001. Step 2: Take a print of the proforma of the application form, or request a hard copy from the concerned authority. Step 3: Fill in all mandatory fields, paste the passport‑sized photograph (signed across), and attach copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest if required). Step 4: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Director or to the ACO‑II, Directorate of Art & Culture, Phone: 0832‑2404623, Email: aco3‑dac.goa@nic.in
